deals.title: Classic Quarter Zip Textured Waffle Polo for 2 for $14 + $18 shipping
deals.sourceText: Picks up a textured waffle knit that gives a standard polo more visual interest, suited to anyone wanting a layering piece between a t-shirt and a sweater. At $14, that's $86 off the $100 list price. Apply coupon code "PMR14" for a savings of $86. Shipping adds $18.
